# Online input relationships with a frozen-parent residual head

1. **Status, lineage and owner.** The implemented screen H-ONLINE-RELATIONSHIPS-20261022-R1 / E-ONLINE-RELATIONSHIPS-20261022-R1 is incomplete at its original worker time cap. The worker ended at 03:10:32 Kyiv on October23 with timeout/SIGTERM after 7,800.451 service seconds. Seven of twelve heads are saved: all six F0 heads and F1/lag1/A. F1/lag1/B stopped after epochs0–1 without a durable checkpoint; four heads never started. Both parent caches remain on approved physical scratch. No quality grading or retry ran. The proposed one-hour allocation transfer remains unanswered and unapproved; the 12-hour production reserve is untouched. [Terminal evidence](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/5ce677916ce028bdafe75bebea0cc14c997e71cf/research/experiment_drafts/online-relationships-20261022/PANEL_TERMINAL_R1.json) and [independent metadata review](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/5ce677916ce028bdafe75bebea0cc14c997e71cf/research/experiment_drafts/online-relationships-20261022/TERMINAL_METADATA_REVIEW_R1.json) record the outcome. Root owns delivery and the independent grader owns validation/scoring. The executed source freeze is `17470a770f2a6aa25be232c017bff45b5d56ad97`; reproducible recipe/admission/launcher packet is root `33c6e33830a89187aaaf08116850864250feed56`. This focused PR is not the executed checkout: four preserved canonical dependency files differ from the frozen run hashes, so its exact source preflight rejects PR HEAD. No PR-branch parity or quality claim is made.

2. **Why it should work.** A causal state of input-only forecasts, pre-update innovations and slopes may reveal residual structure that the frozen parent misses. Arm A adapts the mean only and fixes slope to zero; B adapts slope/intercept through row 98, then freezes; C continues updating slope/intercept. C−A asks whether relationships add value beyond mean adaptation; C−B asks whether continued adaptation helps after warmup. A lower input-prediction loss alone is not evidence of endpoint value. The strongest alternatives are ordinary calibration, fold/seed variation and a learned residual distribution that does not transfer from in-sample parent predictions.

3. **Compute advantage and measured limit.** A 64-unit tanh residual readout reuses each frozen parent; there are no new GRU or teacher fits. The original inclusive gate projected 8,311.440 seconds within the 9,000-second panel ceiling. During delivery, CPU-package heat required lowering the worker from 190% to 100% CPU. The unchanged 7,800-second service cap then ended delivery before the complete panel. The actual service elapsed was 7,800.451 seconds including shutdown; this is a delivery-cost result, not evidence of predictive value. B300 stays deferred, and no production time is borrowed. Any continuation requires the pending allocation decision and fresh bounded recovery admission, retaining completed outputs and charging the interrupted head's refit.

4. **Frozen comparison.** The admitted immutable recipe uses 419 inputs: canonical `standard211` plus matured i0 changes, forecasts, pre-update errors and slopes (52 each). The online state uses raw observations only, updates causally, resets at each sequence, and never reads labels, scoring masks or prediction flags. Separate lag-1 and lag-16 panels are used. The residual is `parent + 0.1 * head`; head output initializes to zero. All arms use strict FP32 with autocast and TF32 off; canonical fitting row weights and WMSE; AdamW at 0.001, weight decay 0.01, gradient clip 1, batches of 8,192 rows, three epochs and fixed epoch-2 checkpoint selection. Fit-only standardization uses a 0.001 standard-deviation floor and clips standardized differences to ±8. Means/covariance start at zero, input variance at one; slope ridge is 0.1 and the state half-life is 512. The exact optimizer, target, parent, sequence and reset contracts are pinned in `EXECUTION_RECIPE_R1.json` and `PANEL_ADMISSION_R1.json`.

5. **Bounded fitting panel.** The explicit lag amendment admits two matched panels: folds 0 and 1 with readout fitting seeds 1001 and 1002, respectively (the two reused parents have their own pinned seed-3 ancestry); each cell has arms A/B/C at lags 1 and 16. This is 4 new readout fits per arm, 2 per arm per lag, and 12 total new fits. Two exact fold-specific parent endpoints are reused across the arms/lags. There are zero new GRU fits, teacher fits or backbone/student fits. Each cell uses the recipe-pinned 10% source-qualified component sample and complete sequences. No additional follow-up fits are included in this admission.

6. **Validation and uncertainty.** The unchanged official metric is `global_wp_clip2_v1`, with its fixed scored/prediction mask, ±2 clipping and original clipped-label magnitude weights. The grader evaluates both targets and four fixed position bins on both source-qualified folds. Planned primary contrasts are C−A, C−B and each arm against its matched parent within each fold/lag; lag-16 minus lag-1 per arm/cell is secondary (26 contrasts total). The paired dependency-component bootstrap is conditional on these fixed endpoints and excludes fitting variation and public transfer. Both folds are exposed; the two fold/seed cells confound those axes and cannot estimate training variance or establish significance. Report every paired delta and interval; do not promote on an isolated positive component interval.

7. **Leakage and coverage.** Online updates are past-only and use raw inputs, not targets, masks or request/score flags. Unavailable backward differences are zero placeholders and excluded from fitting standardization until mature; warmup spans rows 16–98, with 82 real lag-1 and 67 real lag-16 regressor pairs. Sequence state resets on boundaries. Exact cache headers, source-qualified membership, parent normalization and coverage are checked before grading. Parent training predictions are in-sample rather than OOF, so the learned residual distribution may differ on held-out components. All folds used here are exposed; this screen does not create a fresh holdout.

8. **Decision-changing result.** A coherent endpoint improvement for C over A and B supports continued relationship adaptation in this readout; improvement only over A is consistent with calibration rather than ongoing adaptation. An input-loss improvement without official endpoint value earns no expansion. The screen is small, so mixed or imprecise results remain uncertain and can justify only a bounded information-seeking follow-up when its expected value exceeds its cost. Negative evidence narrows this exact readout and panel; it does not reject online learning generally. B has only 83 matured warmup outcomes, with 82/67 real lag-1/lag-16 regressors; C−B cannot establish nonstationarity. Any release also requires actual native endpoint quality and runtime while preserving `PredictionModel.predict`; neither is established here.

9. **How to run and recover.** The exact original run used the root checkout above, its provisioned `.venv`, CPU-only strict FP32 and physical scratch `/home/vlad/development/wunder/research_tmp`. `RUN_DELIVERY_R1.sh` records the finite `prepare-cache` then `fit-panel` commands and frozen preflights. Original unit `wnn-online-panel-r1-20261023.service`, invocation `1e64dd46f5294caba4977275e6c91feb`, retained two numerical threads, a 4,000,000,000-byte memory request, no swap, hidden GPU and the 7,800-second delivery cap. CPU quota was lowered from 190% to 100%; a separate observer was configured to freeze only that invocation at 97°C and thaw its own freeze at 90°C, but no cooling transition was observed. Worker and observer have ended. The separate 600-second quality-grade cap was not used. Do not relaunch the create-only full-panel command over existing outputs. A future authorized recovery must verify/reuse completed cells, refit the interrupted unsaved head, preserve the immutable recipe/source records and fit the newly approved envelope. PR HEAD is not the admitted source and fails its exact source-hash preflight.

10. **Evidence to return.** The execution receipt must bind recipe/source/parent/cache/checkpoint/prediction hashes, all twelve cell identities and fit memberships, loss/LR/preclip gradient norm/updates/checkpoint policy, per-phase wall time and memory, exact output headers, and independent grader source/metric/coverage checks. Return every planned contrast, uncertainty interval and excluded cell; keep prediction/evidence manifests separate from any weight archive and record the approved scratch/archive location. The admission and execution snapshot are immutable JSON; large caches, arrays and weights stay on root's approved disk and are not copied into this PR.

11. **Results and trace.** [Terminal inventory](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/5ce677916ce028bdafe75bebea0cc14c997e71cf/research/experiment_drafts/online-relationships-20261022/TERMINAL_COLLECTION_R1.json) records seven complete candidate file sets, zero metadata errors and five missing candidates. All 27 runtime and 15 grader source pins match; the seven NPY headers have exact `<f4` C-order shapes and payload/header byte counts. [Independent metadata review](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/5ce677916ce028bdafe75bebea0cc14c997e71cf/research/experiment_drafts/online-relationships-20261022/TERMINAL_METADATA_REVIEW_R1.json) accepts that inventory only and keeps full-panel grading closed: twelve candidates/fourteen endpoints are not available. Prediction payload digests and parent endpoint coverage were not independently validated here; no evaluator labels/masks, target quality metric, native quality or native runtime were read or measured. There is no empirical mechanism conclusion or public forecast. [Raw worker log](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/5ce677916ce028bdafe75bebea0cc14c997e71cf/research/experiment_drafts/online-relationships-20261022/panel_execution_r1.log), [observer log](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/5ce677916ce028bdafe75bebea0cc14c997e71cf/research/experiment_drafts/online-relationships-20261022/cpu_observer_r1.log) and [post-terminal resource receipt](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/5ce677916ce028bdafe75bebea0cc14c997e71cf/research/experiment_drafts/online-relationships-20261022/PANEL_TERMINAL_RESOURCE_SNAPSHOT_R1.json) preserve the operational record. The pre-cap durable resource snapshot was missed and final cgroup counters were unavailable; last live reports had zero OOM/swap and systemd retained a 3,999,997,952-byte memory peak. The observer log confirms exit at 03:10:32.373 when the worker ended. Original admission, execution snapshot and recipe bytes remain unchanged. Root commit `5ce677916ce028bdafe75bebea0cc14c997e71cf` records the terminal handoff; the original reproducible source/packet remain `17470a7` / `33c6e33`. This draft's publication is a code/evidence handoff, not a quality result.
